papers.title: Evaluation of Strain-Rate Sensitivity of Selective Laser Melted H13 Tool Steel Using Nanoindentation Tests
papers.abstract: This paper demonstrates the successful printing of H13 tool steel by a selective laser melting (SLM) method at a scan laser speed of 200 mm/s for the best microstructure and mechanical behavior. Specifically, the nanoindentation strain-rate sensitivity values were 0.022, 0.019, 0.027, 0.028, and 0.035 for SLM H13 at laser scan speeds of 100, 200, 400, 800, and 1600 mm/s, respectively. This showed that the hardness increases as the strain rate increases and, practically, the hardness values of the SLM H13 at the 200 mm/s laser scan speed are the highest and least sensitive to the strain rate as compared to H13 samples at other scan speeds. The SLM processing of this material at 200 mm/s laser scan speed therefore shows the highest potential for advanced tool design. Residual stress is expected to affect the hardness and shall be investigated in future research.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是工具钢的激光选区熔化工艺与纳米压痕性能，与生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on H13 tool steel for tooling applications, with no porous structure, no biomedical context, no fatigue testing, and no osseointegration or surface morphology relevant to AM biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究不同激光扫描速度下SLM H13工具钢的应变率敏感性。
summary_zh.method: 采用纳米压痕测试评估不同扫描速度试样的硬度和应变率敏感性。
summary_zh.result: 200 mm/s扫描速度下硬度最高且对应变率最不敏感。
summary_zh.validation: 纳米压痕实验验证力学性能差异。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of laser scan speed on the strain-rate sensitivity of selective laser melted H13 tool steel.
summary_en.method: Nanoindentation tests were performed on H13 samples fabricated at five different laser scan speeds to measure hardness and strain-rate sensitivity.
summary_en.result: The sample fabricated at 200 mm/s exhibited the highest hardness and the lowest strain-rate sensitivity among all tested speeds.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through nanoindentation mechanical testing.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究颈适配器与股骨柄接触面的微动磨损，未涉及股骨近端应力遮挡或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on fretting wear of a neck-stem interface, not on proximal femur stress shielding, micromotion at bone-implant interface, or any biomechanical comparison of intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究小牛血清对颈适配器-股骨柄接触面微动行为的影响
summary_zh.method: 使用Ti-6Al-4V和DLC涂层试样在含小牛血清环境下进行微动磨损实验
summary_zh.result: 小牛血清显著改变摩擦系数和磨损机制，DLC涂层表现出更好的耐磨性
summary_zh.validation: 通过磨损形貌和摩擦系数曲线验证实验结果

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of calf serum on the fretting wear behavior of the neck adapter–femoral stem contact interface.
summary_en.method: Fretting wear tests were conducted on Ti-6Al-4V and diamond-like carbon coated specimens in a calf serum environment.
summary_en.result: Calf serum significantly altered the coefficient of friction and wear mechanisms, with DLC coating showing superior wear resistance.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through wear morphology analysis and friction coefficient measurements.

papers.title: Nature of intrinsic uncertainties in equilibrium molecular dynamics estimation of shear viscosity for simple and complex fluids
papers.abstract: We study two types of intrinsic uncertainties, statistical errors and system size effects, in estimating shear viscosity via equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations, and compare them with the corresponding uncertainties in evaluating the self-diffusion coefficient. Uncertainty quantification formulas for the statistical errors in the shear-stress autocorrelation function and shear viscosity are obtained under the assumption that shear stress follows a Gaussian process. Analyses of simulation results for simple and complex fluids reveal that the Gaussianity is more pronounced in the shear-stress process (related to shear viscosity estimation) compared with the velocity process of an individual molecule (related to self-diffusion coefficient). At relatively high densities corresponding to a liquid state, we observe that the shear viscosity exhibits complex size-dependent behavior unless the system is larger than a certain length scale, and beyond which, reliable shear viscosity values are obtained without any noticeable scaling behavior with respect to the system size. We verify that this size-dependent behavior is configurational and relate the characteristic length scale to the shear-stress correlation length.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究分子动力学中剪切粘度的不确定性量化，与生物力学有限元替代建模无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on molecular dynamics uncertainty quantification for shear viscosity, not on surrogate modeling for FEA, implant design, or biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化平衡分子动力学模拟中剪切粘度估计的固有不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 假设剪切应力为高斯过程，推导统计误差公式，分析简单和复杂流体的模拟结果。
summary_zh.result: 剪切应力过程的高斯性比单分子速度过程更显著；高密度下粘度存在复杂尺寸依赖性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过简单和复杂流体的模拟结果验证理论公式。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify intrinsic uncertainties, including statistical errors and system size effects, in estimating shear viscosity via equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations.
summary_en.method: Derived uncertainty quantification formulas for statistical errors in shear-stress autocorrelation and viscosity under Gaussian process assumption, and analyzed simulation data for simple and complex fluids.
summary_en.result: Gaussianity is more pronounced in shear-stress process than in single-molecule velocity; shear viscosity exhibits complex size-dependent behavior at high densities beyond a characteristic length scale.
summary_en.validation: Validated theoretical formulas through molecular dynamics simulations of simple and complex fluids.
